Subject: Integration: request for solution-fit criteria and simulation scenarios

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. Meridian is preparing a short technical intake so we can move to an architecture alignment and joint simulation run with Redwood. Attached are our current solution requirements (Meridian-Solution-Requirements-v2.xlsx) and a blank simulation matrix (sim-matrix.csv) — we filled a few rows but left the rest for you to populate with Redwood run profiles.

High level asks:
- Confirm fit for our primary use case: low-latency customer support generation (avg prompt length ~120 tokens, 95th perc response <= 350ms)
- Recommend model/quantization profile and batching strategy for predictable p95 latency under 10 RPS sustained
- Identify telemetry/events we need to capture (billing, latency breakdown, cache hit/miss) and any additional security evidence you need from us
- Propose a 2-day joint simulation window and a short success criteria checklist we can sign off on

Can you review and tell us what you need to run an accurate simulation? We’d like to get this scheduled in the week of Mar 16th if possible.

Attachments: Meridian-Solution-Requirements-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), sim-matrix.csv (CSV)

Cheers,

2) Sergio (cc) will draft the test cases and runbook for the joint simulation.

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>

Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-03-03T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integration: request for solution-fit criteria and simulation scenarios

Nora / Jasmine — copying in the technical test plan draft. High-level notes:

Planned test cases (first pass):
- TC1: Baseline latency: single-threaded requests @1 RPS with 120-token prompts (no KV cache). Measure p50/p95/p99 and token-level breakdown.
- TC2: Steady-state throughput: 10 RPS sustained for 30 minutes, batching enabled (batch sizes 4/8), with KV-cache disabled, to observe batching gain and p95 behavior.
- TC3: Cache warm start: simulate 1k unique sessions, then repeat requests to observe cache hit rate impact on p95 latency.
- TC4: Failure mode: simulate sudden 2x traffic spike and verify graceful degradation (fallback to smaller model variant) and correctness of fallback outputs.
- TC5: Quality regression: sample generation outputs with the current model and with recommended quantized variant; run automatic evals against your prompt set.

Initial questions:
- Authentication: will Meridian provide a short-term API key for the simulation, or do you prefer we test through a connector installed in your staging VPC?
- Telemetry: we recommend sending latency/event traces to our tracing endpoint + a daily summary CSV export. We’ll need a sample log schema for request identifiers so we can correlate traces.

I populated the sim-matrix with Redwood run profiles and left two columns for Meridian to mark expected success thresholds. Attaching the populated sim-matrix.csv (first pass).

Attachments: sim-matrix.csv (CSV)

— Sergio
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@meridian.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Integration: request for solution-fit criteria and simulation scenarios

Thanks — this is great. A few answers/notes:
- KV cache: yes, we expect session-level KV-cache to be used for customer context (so please include a cache-warm TC).
- Max tokens: outputs may be up to 800 tokens for long-form follow-ups; however our typical case is <= 300 tokens. Please ensure memory and latency planning covers the 800-token tail.
- Regions: primary test in us-west, secondary spot checks in eu-west (we’ll provide a short-lived eu staging endpoint).

Authentication: we prefer a connector inside our staging VPC (we’ll share access), not a public API key.

Compliance/evidence: I’ve attached an updated requirements sheet with our audit checklist column filled (Meridian-Solution-Requirements-v2.xlsx). For the DocuSign on the DPA addendum, please route to legal@meridian.ai; we’ll counter-sign quickly once the runbook and success criteria are confirmed. DocuSign link: DOCUSIGN-987654321

Proposed simulation window: Mar 23–24 (US daytime). If that works, let’s lock it and we’ll provision the staging VPC connector.

Best,
Nora
